purpose: Phase-0 G6 reference point: current ML layer state, for Phase-7 ablation comparison (thin XGBoost vs physics-feature model). NOT acceptance evidence.
claim_scope: Phase 10 post-simulation ML decision-support analysis only; labels are derived from simulation outputs and do not prove real-world calibration, publication readiness, final-study readiness, formal acceptance, or operational forecasting.

input.caveat_graph_stub: Input CSV predates the G5 finding: the Goseong case-study road graph is a length-stubbed skeleton (see docs/validation_anchor.md sec.3), so bus_only-derived features reflect the stub, not real transport. macro_f1 here measures the CURRENT pipeline, not a validated model.

model.class_count_note: kci_redesign docs claimed 4 classes (jeongsang/juju/wihoe/silpae-wihoe); ACTUAL code = 3 classes. Corrected in kci_redesign 01/02 sec.5.
model.leakage_boundary: Features limited to policy/scenario/mode fields and selected edge count; completion_rate and censored_count used only for label derivation, not as model features.

imbalance_note: risk class = 3.5% of rows (549/15870); heavily imbalanced. macro_f1 weights the minority class, hence macro_f1 (0.887) << accuracy (0.949).

implemented_components.note: kci_redesign 01/02 + CLAUDE.md over-claimed KMeans+SHAP+NL as implemented. ACTUAL: XGBoost + feature_importance only. KMeans/SHAP/NL are Phase-7 planned work. shap not installed in env.

phase7_ablation_anchor: Compare this thin-XGBoost macro_f1=0.887 (3-class, 40 non-physics features) against the Phase-7 physics-feature model (threat_index / mode-mix / fallback / critical-link survival / corridor-id / BPR v,c / transfer / fleet).
